extracted.name: Quick chickpea & chard tamarind curry
extracted.description: Give this vegan curry a lift with some tamarind, chickpeas and chard – it packs in real depth of flavour. Serve with brown rice
ingredient_lines: 1 large bunch of chard (about 400g), stalks finely chopped and leaves torn
1 tsp chilli powder hot or mild
300ml vegetable stock made with 1 stock cube
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a large pan over a medium heat and fry the chard stalks and spring onions for 3 mins until softened. Stir in the garlic and spices and cook for 2-3 mins until fragrant.
Pour in the stock, chickpeas, tamarind and coconut milk. Cover. Simmer for 15 mins, then stir in the chard leaves. Cook until just wilted, then season to taste. Serve with brown rice.
